grammar.title: Places to Go — Vocabulary
grammar.rule:
📘 **Места, куда можно пойти**:

🎨 **art gallery** — картинная галерея
🎭 **theatre** — театр
🎵 **concert hall** — концертный зал
🎢 **adventure park** — парк аттракционов
🍔 **fast food restaurant** — ресторан быстрого питания
🐾 **zoo** — зоопарк

📌 **Что можно делать в этих местах**:
✅ look at paintings — смотреть на картины
✅ watch a play — смотреть спектакль
✅ listen to music — слушать музыку
✅ go on a roller coaster — кататься на американских горках
✅ eat a burger — есть бургер
✅ see wild animals — видеть диких животных

📌 **Пример**:
You can see wild animals at the zoo.
You can listen to music at the concert hall.

vocabulary.example: We went to an art gallery.
We watch a play at the theatre.
We listen to music at a concert.
We went to an adventure park.
I went on a roller coaster.
We saw animals at the zoo.

grammar.title: Past Simple (regular verbs)
grammar.rule:
📘 **Past Simple — прошедшее время**:

Мы используем Past Simple, когда говорим о действиях, которые произошли в прошлом.

📌 **Как образуется Past Simple**:
✅ глагол + **-ed**: play → played, walk → walked
✅ глагол + **-d** (если оканчивается на -e): like → liked
✅ y → ied (если оканчивается на согласную + y): try → tried
✅ удвоение последней согласной: stop → stopped

📌 **Отрицание**:
❌ I **didn't** play football yesterday.

📌 **Вопрос**:
❓ **Did** you play football yesterday?
✅ Yes, I did. / ❌ No, I didn't.

📌 **Слова-помощники**:
yesterday, last night, last week, two days ago

📌 **Пример**:
I **played** football yesterday.
I **didn't** watch TV last night.
**Did** you visit your grandparents?

exercises.question: I ___ football yesterday. ⚽
She ___ dinner last night. 🍕
I ___ (walk) to school yesterday. 🚶
___ you watch TV last night? 📺 — No, I didn't.
I didn't played football yesterday.
exercises.explanation: After 'didn't' we use the base form: play, not played! ⚽

days.title: Day 3: Past Simple — Spelling Rules
days.description: Учим правила правописания в Past Simple

grammar.title: Past Simple — Spelling Rules
grammar.rule:
📘 **Правила правописания в Past Simple**:

📌 **1. Большинство глаголов** → +ed:
✅ play → **played**, walk → **walked**, watch → **watched**

📌 **2. Глаголы на -e** → +d:
✅ like → **liked**, dance → **danced**, live → **lived**

📌 **3. Глаголы на согласную + y** → y → ied:
✅ try → **tried**, cry → **cried**, study → **studied**

📌 **4. Глаголы на гласную + y** → +ed:
✅ play → **played** (y остаётся), enjoy → **enjoyed**

📌 **5. Короткие глаголы (согласная-гласная-согласная)** → удвоить последнюю согласную + ed:
✅ stop → **stopped**, drop → **dropped**, plan → **planned**

📌 **Пример**:
I **tried** to call you, but you didn't answer.
She **stopped** playing games and started doing homework.

vocabulary.example: She cried because she was sad.
vocabulary.context_example: Она плакала, потому что была грустна.

days.title: Day 4: Reading — Email about a Weekend
days.description: Читаем письмо о выходных в парке аттракционов

grammar.title: Чтение и понимание текста
grammar.rule:
📚 **Стратегия чтения**:
1️⃣ Прочитай письмо целиком, чтобы понять общий смысл.
2️⃣ Найди, куда ходил герой и что он делал.
3️⃣ Прочитай вопросы и найди ответы в тексте.

💡 **Совет**: Обрати внимание на глаголы в Past Simple!

exercises.question: Where did Sam go last weekend? 🎢
exercises.explanation: Sam went to the Crazy Ride Adventure Park! 🎢
exercises.readingText:
🌟 EMAIL ABOUT A WEEKEND 🌟

From: Sam
To: Sergei
Subject: Guess where I was!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Hi, Sergei,

I hope you're well. Guess where I was last weekend! I decided to go to the Crazy Ride Adventure Park with my friends. The weather was great. There were a lot of people there.

There were so many rides I couldn't choose which one to go on. I tried the Mega roller coaster. It was great! We wanted to go to the Hall of Mirrors but we didn't because there was a very long queue. We tried candyfloss but I didn't like it. We stayed until late in the evening.

What about you? Did you visit your grandparents?

Write back soon.

Sam

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💬 QUESTIONS ABOUT THE EMAIL
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

grammar.title: Past Simple — практика
grammar.rule:
📘 **Вспоминаем Past Simple**:

📌 **Утверждение**:
✅ I **walked** to school yesterday.
✅ She **cooked** dinner last night.

📌 **Отрицание**:
❌ I **didn't walk** to school.
❌ She **didn't cook** dinner.

📌 **Вопрос**:
❓ **Did** you walk to school?
✅ Yes, I did. / ❌ No, I didn't.

📌 **Слова-помощники**:
yesterday, last night, last week, last month, ago

exercises.question: I ___ TV last night. 📺
___ you play football yesterday? ⚽ — Yes, I did.
In Past Simple, we use 'didn't' + verb + -ed.
exercises.explanation: We use 'didn't' + base form: I didn't play, NOT didn't played! ⚽

exercises.question: We ___ (stay) at the park until 8 pm. 🎢
I didn't liked the film.
exercises.explanation: After 'didn't' we use the base form: like, not liked! 🎬

days.title: Day 6: Writing — Email about Last Weekend
days.description: Пишем письмо другу о своих выходных

grammar.title: Повторение: Past Simple
grammar.rule:
📚 **План для письма**:

1️⃣ Where did you go? (Куда ты ходил?)
2️⃣ Who was with you? (Кто был с тобой?)
3️⃣ What did you do? (Что ты делал?)
4️⃣ What did you eat? (Что ты ел?)
5️⃣ Did you like it? (Тебе понравилось?)

📌 **Пример**:
Dear Sergei,

Last weekend, I went to the adventure park with my friends. The weather was great. I tried the roller coaster and it was amazing! We also played games and ate pizza. I stayed until late in the evening. I had a fantastic time!

Write back soon!

Sam
